title: ceiba jasminodora
intro: Ceiba jasminodora, commonly known as Kapok, is a tropical tree native to Central and South America, its trunk is covered with soft, downy hairs. The health benefits of Ceiba jasminodora include its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Ceiba jasminodora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
